tasks.instruction: Match each description (A-L) to the correct country. Three descriptions do not match any of them.

options.text: Saint David's Day is celebrated here on the first of March.
It is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea.
Its national flower is the thistle and its patron saint is Saint Andrew.
Its capital city is Dublin and the shamrock is its emblem.
Its flag carries a red dragon, and its capital city is Cardiff.
Its national flower is the rose and its patron saint is Saint George.
The Lake District, a national park of mountains and lakes, is here.
It has no coastline of its own and is entirely surrounded by other countries.
The New Year celebration held here is known as Hogmanay.
Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the United Kingdom, stands here.
The daffodil and the leek are both national emblems here.
William Shakespeare was born here, in Stratford-upon-Avon.
